note: 20-50 real failure/control cases (D10). Every case carries a task input, an environment fixture, the critical constraint, expected/forbidden actions, deterministic transcript/outcome assertions and a layer-1 baseline record whose provenance is machine-verified by executable probes. Case families follow research/03-metrics-and-experiment.md plus the P0.3 Code Guidance list.

provenance_classes.corpus-observed: the failure is one of the five committed P0.1 corpus cases; probes bind the bank case to that corpus case_id and to the committed session evidence
provenance_classes.bundle-observed: the failure is recorded in a committed source-evidence runtime snapshot; probes bind the bank case to the exact snapshot text
provenance_classes.absent-control-derived: the failure is derived from a control that provably does not exist in the repository at freeze time; probes assert that absence (and, where a library check exists but has no session-boundary caller, assert both the presence of the library check and the absence of the caller)
